description: This file contains PHP code for generating and displaying a metrics dashboard within a test management project. It includes functions for retrieving test plan metrics, configuring table columns, and initializing environment context. The main script processes test plan data, constructs a dynamic table, and renders the metrics dashboard for a testing project in TestLink.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering and managing interactive tables, including grouping, sorting, and toolbar controls within the dashboard.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves test plan metrics including status counts, platform data, and build information, optionally considering multiple platforms.

methods.name: getPercentage
methods.description: Calculates and returns a percentage value, rounded to specified precision, given numerator and denominator.

methods.name: getColumnsDefinition
methods.description: Defines the schema for table columns including labels, widths, types, and filters, based on whether platforms are displayed and available statuses.

methods.name: collectTestProjectMetrics
methods.description: Aggregates overall test plan progress metrics for display, including executed and active test cases per status.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks whether a user has specific rights (permissions) on test project or test plan contexts.
